classification_semantics.PURE_AGENTIC: The substantive decision is delegated to open-ended LLM reasoning. Generic tool transport, schema checks and logging alone do not make a node hybrid. No current registered operational entity is assigned this mode.
classification_semantics.PURE_ALGORITHMIC: Substantive decisions and state changes follow specified numerical methods, predicates, solvers or state machines without runtime LLM judgment. External observations can be uncertain; this does not make the decision agentic.
classification_semantics.HYBRID: LLM interpretation affects a proposal or assessment, while substantive numerical policy and deterministic admission jointly determine the accepted result. Aggregate containers inherit this mode from their children.

coverage_rule: Exactly one entry for every active non-edge entity in scope. Retired VIDs remain tombstones. Edges are deterministic routing/transition rules, not independent decision makers.
implementation_boundary: These are architecture decisions, not claims of completed implementation or grants of live trading authority.
broker_mutation_authority: Only the deterministic Command Commit Guard may admit a mutation, using valid upstream authority and injected ledger/broker dependencies. No LLM receives a direct broker mutation path.
change_policy: Changing decision mode, LLM authority or a supporting contract requires an explicit architecture revision and renewed validation; a different orchestrator or model choice does not silently change mode.

entries.name: Master Architecture

hybrid_boundary.invalid_or_unavailable: Use the affected child policy; keep independent hard monitoring and execution recovery available.

entries.name: Start / Wake
entries.rationale: Wake conditions, session identity and duplicate-start suppression are explicit orchestration rules.

entries.name: Fan out one Trade Selection instance per selected X
entries.rationale: Fan out exactly once per valid underlying commitment and instance identity; reasoning must not create duplicate graphs or unreserved work.

entries.name: Start / scheduled regime review
entries.rationale: Trigger a review from approved time or event conditions, preserving review identity and rate limits.

entries.name: Collect regime-relevant market context
entries.rationale: Code acquires numerical observations and checks provenance, timestamps and duplicates; an LLM identifies relevant news, interprets events and assembles evidence-backed context.

hybrid_boundary.llm_may: Select relevant sources, summarize events, identify transmission channels, flag contradictions and propose evidence-backed event labels.
hybrid_boundary.code_must: Acquire measured data; retain source/time provenance; deduplicate; validate evidence references and field types; prevent invented numerical observations from entering trusted state.
hybrid_boundary.invalid_or_unavailable: Mark contextual evidence incomplete; downstream regime assessment becomes UNCERTAIN and cannot permit new short gamma.

entries.name: Multi-day Regime Gate
entries.rationale: An LLM synthesizes multi-day evidence and proposes a regime. Code enforces the calibrated policy, evidence sufficiency, expiry and hard prohibitions before publishing an admissible decision.

hybrid_boundary.llm_may: Propose FAVORABLE, UNFAVORABLE or UNCERTAIN from supplied evidence, with reasons and bounded typed review-trigger proposals.
hybrid_boundary.code_must: Enforce the versioned regime policy, calibrated numerical gates, evidence sufficiency, hard prohibitions, maximum validity and a fixed invalidation vocabulary.
hybrid_boundary.invalid_or_unavailable: Publish UNCERTAIN or retain an independently still-valid prior certificate only until its precommitted expiry; never extend validity or create new permission.

entries.name: Hand off to Underlying Allocation

entries.name: Volarb Execution + Risk Management Engine
entries.rationale: An LLM may choose an economic response from admissible alternatives; code computes exposures, enforces limits and versions intent. This orchestrator delegates judgment to the monitoring/action nodes.

hybrid_boundary.llm_may: Coordinate economic interpretation and propose changes to intended exposure through the monitoring and action-selection nodes.
hybrid_boundary.code_must: Own numerical risk, admissible action sets, current state/version, exact sizing, intent publication and mandatory risk responses. Reuse child judgment rather than require another model call.
hybrid_boundary.invalid_or_unavailable: Suspend discretionary risk increases; keep deterministic monitoring, reconciliation and mandatory risk responses running.

entries.name: Build intended execution plan
entries.rationale: Compile an accepted economic decision into exact instrument identities, signed quantities, constraints and runtime versions. An underspecified decision returns for clarification instead of being guessed.

entries.name: Pre-trade Margin Feasibility Check
entries.rationale: Use current normalized broker margin/account facts for the actual proposed transition, including live orders and existing positions; infeasibility returns to strategy policy.

entries.name: BrokerMarginFeasibilityPort
entries.rationale: A typed query/normalization interface transports broker facts. It has no discretion to grant margin or reinterpret feasibility.

entries.name: Atomic broker-neutral instrument execution intent
entries.rationale: Schema validation and serialization are algorithmic. The economic judgment, if any, belongs to the producing box; this record carries its validated result and provenance without adding discretion.
entries.registry_context: One desired instrument-level economic action. Multiple instances may be handed to Execution Engine concurrently. Strategy meaning remains in Position Management; broker identifiers remain below the broker port.

entries.name: OptimalExecutionPort
entries.rationale: Validate and transport versioned broker-neutral economic intent to the generic engine. Transport does not add strategy authority.
entries.registry_context: Position Management handoff to broker-neutral Execution Engine.

entries.name: Live execution / risk / monitoring policy
entries.rationale: Deterministic monitors enforce continuous hard risk conditions; an LLM periodically interprets changing context. Mandatory risk actions must proceed without waiting for the LLM.

hybrid_boundary.llm_may: Interpret new context and request a bounded strategic review at a slower cadence than the mechanical risk monitors.
hybrid_boundary.code_must: Continuously enforce approved loss, exposure, session and data-validity rules; issue authorized hard interrupts without waiting for a model; reject stale contextual results.
hybrid_boundary.invalid_or_unavailable: Continue hard monitoring and mandatory action. Missing LLM output is never permission to HOLD through a breached limit.

entries.name: Hold / adjust / recenter / hedge / reduce / exit
entries.rationale: An LLM selects or explains an admissible economic action; code independently evaluates its quantitative consequences and enforces mandatory exits, constraints and authorization.

hybrid_boundary.llm_may: Choose among admissible HOLD, ADJUST, RECENTRE, HEDGE, REDUCE and EXIT proposals and explain the economic rationale.
hybrid_boundary.code_must: Generate or validate exact candidates, recompute risk and transition margin, enforce covenant/allowlist/version constraints, and emit accepted versioned intent. Mandatory risk actions override discretionary choices.
hybrid_boundary.invalid_or_unavailable: Reject the discretionary proposal; apply the independently authorized risk policy for existing exposure, including required exits. Never manufacture HOLD as a universal fallback.

entries.name: Provider Error Envelope
entries.rationale: Schema validation and serialization are algorithmic. The economic judgment, if any, belongs to the producing box; this record carries its validated result and provenance without adding discretion.
entries.registry_context: Global broker/provider-neutral error contract consumed by any Volarb box calling an external provider. Every provider-native failure must map into a stable global category/code/outcome while retaining provider provenance; unknown native errors map to UNKNOWN rather than leaking raw exceptions.
